pages.text: Kings & Monsters fills the wilds with organized threats, guarded territory, rare trophies, and rulers who do not surrender their crowns politely.$(br2)Explore ogre camps, learn what provokes the Tribe, and follow the trail toward its King. Curiosity is rewarded. Carelessness is punished—an unprepared traveler can be overwhelmed quickly.

pages.title: Read the Signs
pages.text: Real items in this compendium can be hovered for their normal tooltips. Recipe pages also use the recipes loaded by the game.
